name: Persian & Turkish Remedies
summary: Ihlamur, sekanjabin, barley soup and nane-limon from Persian and Turkish homes.

remedies.name: Ihlamur
remedies.howItHelps: Turkish linden tea with lemon and honey, the classic winter cold remedy.
steps: Steep linden flowers in hot water.
Add lemon and honey when warm.
remedies.caution: Honey is fine for big kids, never for babies under one year.

remedies.name: Nane Limon
remedies.howItHelps: Mint and lemon tea, for colds and grumbly tummies.
steps: Boil dried mint with lemon slices.

remedies.name: Sekanjabin with Cucumber
remedies.howItHelps: A Persian mint and vinegar syrup mixed with cool water and grated cucumber for hot days.
steps: Stir a spoon of sekanjabin into cold water.

remedies.name: Barley Soup
remedies.howItHelps: Warm barley soup is the Persian sick-day meal.
steps: Simmer barley with carrots and a little lemon.
